import numpy as np

np.random.seed(42)
n = 1000

X = np.random.randn(n)

Z = np.random.randn(n)
Y = 0.7 * X + np.sqrt(1 - 0.7**2) * Z

cov_matrix = np.cov(X, Y)

cov_XY = cov_matrix[0, 1]

corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(X, Y)

corr_XY = corr_matrix[0, 1]

manual_corr = cov_XY / (np.std(X) * np.std(Y))

W = -2 * X + 3

cov_XW = np.cov(X, W)[0, 1]
corr_XW = np.corrcoef(X, W)[0, 1]

cov_X_YplusZ = np.cov(X, Y + Z)[0, 1]
corr_X_YplusZ = np.corrcoef(X, Y + Z)[0, 1]

print(f"Covariance matrix:\n{cov_matrix}")
print(f"Cov(X, Y) = {cov_XY:.4f}")
print(f"Corr(X, Y) = {corr_XY:.4f}")
print(f"Manual correlation: {manual_corr:.4f}")
print(f"Cov(X, W) = {cov_XW:.4f}, Corr(X, W) = {corr_XW:.4f}")
